backlog.title: Tesla China October wholesale sales total 67,829, lowest since February
backlog.summary:
Tesla China's October wholesale sales rose 10.30% year-on-year but fell 28.88% from September.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Tesla China reported 67,829 wholesale units in October, marking a 28.88% decline from September and the lowest monthly volume since February.
Despite the monthly slump, Tesla's year-to-date wholesale sales reached 810,889 units, a 21.42% increase compared to the same period last year.
Tesla's growth rate in October slightly trailed the broader Chinese NEV market, highlighting increased competitive pressure from domestic manufacturers.
The Shanghai factory's reliance on exports has grown significantly, with overseas shipments accounting for nearly half of total wholesale sales in the first nine months of 2026.

backlog.title: Apple Earnings, Memory Problems, The Hardware Company Regression
backlog.summary: Apple's earnings suggest that the company's hardware business is doing better than ever, even in the face of memory challenges. Does the software story help or hurt?
bullets: Apple's recent earnings report demonstrates that its core hardware business remains exceptionally resilient despite ongoing volatility in the memory market.
The company is navigating significant supply chain and component cost pressures, yet it continues to maintain strong margins through its hardware-centric model.

There is an emerging tension regarding whether Apple's software and services strategy is effectively complementing its hardware sales or if the company is regressing toward a traditional hardware-first dependency.
Investors must weigh the long-term sustainability of Apple's hardware dominance against the potential risks posed by cyclical memory component challenges and shifting software integration strategies.

backlog.title: Nio adds 10 million battery swaps in 88 days, taking total past 130 million
backlog.summary:
Nio said daily battery swaps averaged more than 110,000 over the past 88 days.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Nio has surpassed 130 million cumulative battery swaps, with a daily average of 110,000 swaps recorded over the last 88 days.
The company's infrastructure network now includes 4,236 swap stations in China, with 84.5% of users located within 3 kilometers of a facility.
The deployment of fifth-generation swap stations enables cross-brand compatibility, allowing Nio, Onvo, and Firefly vehicles to share the same infrastructure.
Nio estimates that its swapping network has saved users approximately 110 million hours of waiting time compared to traditional charging methods.

backlog.title: 3D-IC Signal Integrity: From Silicon Interposers To System Signoff
backlog.summary:
A unified, system-level environment that aggregates several proven technologies into a seamless workflow spanning architecture exploration, electromagnetic extraction, channel simulation, protocol compliance verification, and final system-level signoff.
The post 3D-IC Signal Integrity: From Silicon Interposers To System Signoff appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: The shift toward chiplet-based AI and HPC architectures necessitates moving signal integrity analysis from component-level validation to full system-level channel analysis.
Unified workflows are required to integrate architecture exploration, electromagnetic extraction, and protocol compliance verification into a single signoff process.
Advanced 3D-IC designs require seamless integration of disparate EDA technologies to manage the increased complexity of multi-die signal paths.

backlog.title: Validate Sovereign AI Sites Before You Commit Capital: eBook

How to validate sites before commitment, protect capacity after deployment, and plan for long-term performance.
The post Validate Sovereign AI Sites Before You Commit Capital: eBook appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Sovereign AI infrastructure projects face high risks where data residency and compliance requirements limit operational flexibility, making site validation critical.
Digital twin platforms allow teams to model thermal performance, cooling, and airflow under real-world scenarios before physical deployment.
Physics-based validation can uncover hidden infrastructure failures, such as cooling mismatches, that are not apparent in initial design reviews.

backlog.title: Accelerating Plug-And-Play Prototyping In Chiplet-Based Designs

Engineering teams face critical challenges when hardware-accelerated verification tools operate at different speeds than the actual design under test.

backlog.title: Xpeng unveils GroundingPI pre-trained model, outperforming GPT-6 Astra in perception benchmarks

The model focuses on 'perception-first' spatial localization and does not require joint action labels during training, which Xpeng claims reduces the cost of collecting robot demonstration data.
With a parameter scale of 4 billion, the model is designed to serve as the 'fast system' for embodied intelligence, handling high-speed perception and physical interaction tasks.

backlog.title: Baidu unveils Apollo World model to let AI teach AI to drive

backlog.title: Why Testing Automated Driving Is Harder Than It Looks
backlog.summary:
Instead of waiting for rare situations to occur on public roads, engineers can create those situations virtually. 
The post Why Testing Automated Driving Is Harder Than It Looks appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: The 'scenario explosion' problem makes physical road testing insufficient for validating ADAS, as the number of variables in weather, traffic, and sensor conditions is effectively infinite.
Validation is evolving into a portfolio management challenge where engineers must use virtual simulation to prove consistent system reliability across millions of potential edge cases.
Proving safety in software-defined vehicles requires rigorous coverage metrics that go far beyond successful navigation of a single urban environment.

backlog.title: Adding Network Security To AI, HPC, And Data Centers
backlog.summary:
The location of security functions such as MACsec or IPsec has become a key architectural decision.
The post Adding Network Security To AI, HPC, And Data Centers appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Modern AI and HPC data centers are shifting toward multi-terabit network speeds, necessitating hardware-accelerated security architectures like MACsec and IPsec.

Architectural decisions regarding security placement—whether in switch ASICs, external PHYs, or pluggable modules—are increasingly driven by total cost of ownership and supply-chain constraints rather than just technical performance.

Transport-level security, such as RoCEv2 or Ultra Ethernet, is becoming essential for end-to-end workload protection, requiring security mechanisms that remain transparent to the underlying high-speed fabric.

backlog.title: A new bill could change how the US builds energy infrastructure
backlog.summary: A sweeping bit of legislation designed to cut red tape could speed up the buildout of energy infrastructure in the US. With the dust barely settled on this week’s momentous midterms, the Senate is set to vote on the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (BAAJA) on November 9. It’s a plan that could finally…
bullets: The Senate is scheduled to vote on the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (BAAJA) on November 9, a 417-page bill aimed at streamlining the complex federal permitting process for energy infrastructure.
The legislation is technology-neutral, potentially accelerating the deployment of both fossil fuel and renewable energy projects by narrowing permit requirements and imposing strict review deadlines.
The White House and various clean energy industry groups support the bill, with projections suggesting it could unlock 350 gigawatts of new clean energy capacity for the national grid.

The bill faces opposition from environmental groups concerned that the reduction in regulatory oversight could lead to increased industrial pollution and weakened protections under the National Environmental Policy Act.

The interview highlights the evolution of Intuit’s business model, specifically focusing on the transition from legacy products like Quicken to modern, AI-integrated ecosystems.

backlog.title: Choosing The Right Power Transistor: Why Application Fit Matters More Than Technology
backlog.summary:
Silicon MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC MOSFETs, and GaN HEMTs each offer meaningful advantages, but those advantages do not carry the same value across every converter, motor drive, or power stage.
The post Choosing The Right Power Transistor: Why Application Fit Matters More Than Technology appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Selecting power transistors like SiC MOSFETs or GaN HEMTs requires matching device behavior to specific application demands rather than relying on universal technology superiority.
Designers must evaluate critical factors including bus voltage, switching frequency, commutation behavior, and thermal margins to optimize system-level performance.
Hardware validation remains essential, as simulation models may not fully capture the impact of PCB parasitics and complex control strategies on device efficiency.

backlog.title: Adding Network Security to AI, HPC and Data Centers

How data center operators can protect critical data and communications without compromising the performance demanded by distributed AI and HPC workloads.

bullets: Modern AI and HPC data centers are bifurcating into distinct front-end and back-end network domains to handle specific performance and scalability requirements.

Operators must implement security protocols that protect critical data without introducing latency that would degrade the performance of distributed AI workloads.

bullets:

Securing the agentic enterprise with data lineage
Data lineage is the new security perimeter, providing the visibility needed for governance, accountability, and trust, without impeding AI adoption at scale.

In partnership withCyberhaven
A sales representative asks an AI agent for customer pricing, and the agent pulls data from multiple sources: restricted pricing systems, internal communications, and archived quotes.
The output looks accurate to the agent, so a second agent uses the data to draft the proposal for the sales rep.
No human checks either handoff.

backlog.title: Why Integrated Gate Drive Regulation Matters For High Reliability Space GaN Designs
backlog.summary:
Eliminating the need for a separate bias regulator dedicated to the gate driver for a more streamlined power architecture.
The post Why Integrated Gate Drive Regulation Matters For High Reliability Space GaN Designs appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Integrating low dropout regulators (LDOs) directly into GaN gate drivers simplifies power architectures for space applications by eliminating the need for external bias circuits.
Precise voltage regulation is critical for GaN devices, as even minor fluctuations can degrade switching efficiency, increase EMI, and compromise long-term reliability in extreme environments.
Reducing the total bill of materials (BOM) through integration lowers weight and qualification costs, which are significant barriers for satellite and aerospace power system designs.

backlog.title: Fitting AI Models To Edge Applications
backlog.summary:
Compression can shrink AI models, but efficient edge deployment starts with matching the architecture to the workload and hardware limits.
The post Fitting AI Models To Edge Applications appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Edge AI deployment is shifting focus from raw compute power to bandwidth and memory efficiency, as high-parameter models often exceed the power and thermal limits of embedded devices.
Techniques such as quantization, self-compression, and distillation are critical for right-sizing models to match specific hardware constraints without sacrificing intelligence.
Designers must define the application's purpose first to avoid the performance penalties associated with oversized models in constrained environments like IoT and automotive systems.

backlog.title: Turning Conv2D Into A Practical GPU Compute Pattern
backlog.summary:
A reusable optimization mindset for engineers building GPU compute kernels.
The post Turning Conv2D Into A Practical GPU Compute Pattern appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Engineers can optimize 2D convolution performance by reframing it as a structured matrix multiplication problem rather than a unique mathematical primitive.
Using NHWC data layouts allows spatial feature vectors to be processed as matrix rows, significantly simplifying implementation and improving cache efficiency on GPU hardware.
This approach reduces the complexity of custom kernel development by leveraging well-understood loop ordering and memory traffic management strategies.

backlog.title: Zotye's right-hand-drive Wink Y01 rolls off line, with deliveries planned for early 2027
backlog.summary:
The new model targets overseas markets, with Zotye focusing on India and Indonesia.

bullets: Zotye Auto has produced a right-hand-drive version of its Wink Y01, with mass production and deliveries targeted for early 2027.
The company is focusing its international expansion on India and Indonesia, aiming to establish dealer agreements in 25 countries by the end of 2026.
Despite the production milestone, Zotye cautioned that the project faces significant funding uncertainty and has yet to generate any sales.
The firm's recovery remains fragile, as it requires continued investment to move from trial production to a sustainable global distribution network.

backlog.title: Mercedes-Geely venture Smart expands #2 roll-out in China with Premium trim
backlog.summary:
The Smart #2 Premium has launched in China with a limited-time starting price of 99,900 yuan ($14,880) after incentives.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: The Smart #2 Premium trim has launched in China with a limited-time starting price of 99,900 yuan, targeting the ultra-compact city car segment.
Built on the Electric Compact Architecture (ECA), the 2-seater vehicle is equipped with a 35.8-kWh CATL battery that delivers a CLTC range of 410 km.
The model features an 11-in-1 integrated electric drive system and supports fast charging, capable of replenishing 30% to 80% of the battery in 15 minutes.
Smart is leveraging aggressive purchase incentives, including trade-in subsidies for existing combustion-engine Smart owners, to drive adoption of the new EV.

backlog.title: Lynk & Co to debut 900L on November 10, adding 7-seat version to flagship 900 lineup
backlog.summary:
The Lynk & Co 900L measures 5,280 mm in length with a wheelbase of 3,170 mm, both exceeding the current 900.

bullets: Lynk & Co will debut the 900L, a large 7-seat SUV, on November 10 to expand its flagship 900 series lineup.
The model is built on the SPA Evo hybrid architecture and features a 2.0T plug-in hybrid powertrain with LiDAR-enabled driver assistance.
The launch comes as the brand faces significant sales pressure, with October volume declining 45.4% year-on-year.

backlog.title: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
backlog.summary: I’m not the sort of person who typically pays for a house cleaner. I’m too frugal, and I kind of enjoy putting on a podcast and going to town on my tub with a Magic Eraser. But when I saw an X post about a new humanoid-robot cleaning service in San Francisco, I immediately signed…
bullets: Startup Tau Robotics is currently deploying humanoid robots for residential cleaning services in San Francisco, though the units are not yet fully autonomous.
The robots operate via remote human teleoperation, using onboard cameras to navigate and perform tasks while simultaneously collecting training data to improve future autonomous capabilities.

Despite the novelty, the service remains inefficient and slow compared to manual labor, with pricing currently ranging from $60 to $100 per visit as the company prioritizes data acquisition over immediate profitability.

backlog.title: Geely adds new special editions to hot-selling Xingyuan EV after hitting 1-million milestone
backlog.summary:
The official guidance prices for the two new versions are both 91,800 yuan ($13,670), with a limited-time benefit price of 88,800 yuan.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Geely has introduced two new special editions of the Xingyuan EV, priced at 91,800 yuan with a limited-time incentive of 88,800 yuan.
The model features the Flyme Auto 2.0 cockpit powered by the 7nm StarDragon 1 chip and the G-ASD H3 assisted driving system.
The Xingyuan continues to be a volume driver for Geely, having surpassed 1 million cumulative units with over 70,000 sales recorded in October alone.

backlog.title: Tesla retail sales in China fall to lowest since July 2022 as export share hits record
backlog.summary:
Tesla sold only 8,817 vehicles in China in October, down 66.10% year-on-year.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Tesla's domestic retail sales in China plummeted to 8,817 units in October, the lowest level since July 2022.
The Shanghai factory shifted its focus heavily toward exports, which accounted for a record 87% of monthly wholesale volume.
Tesla's share of the Chinese NEV market dropped to 0.80%, reflecting a significant decline in domestic competitiveness compared to the previous year.

backlog.title: Learning the Language of the Brain’s Cell Types
backlog.summary: How linking neural activity to cell identity will help build models of the brain and reveal new therapeutic targets
bullets: Artificial neural networks rely on uniform computational units, whereas biological brains utilize a diverse array of specialized cell types evolved over millions of years.
The current inability to link specific neuron identities to real-time electrical activity in living brains hinders our understanding of complex cognitive functions and disease pathology.
Researchers propose creating an 'ImageNet for cell types' to standardize a reference dataset that maps specific neuron types to their unique electrical signatures.

Developing this classification system could enable AI to interpret neural recordings from living humans, potentially accelerating the development of biologically realistic AI models and new therapeutic interventions.

backlog.title: The backlash about data centers might really just be about electricity
backlog.summary: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here. As voters went to the polls across the US last week, I was in Ashburn, Virginia, part of what’s known as Data Center Alley—the world’s largest data center hub. It’s also where…
bullets: The growing public backlash against data centers is increasingly driven by physical electricity constraints rather than abstract cultural concerns.
Data centers in hubs like Loudoun County, Virginia, now average 54 megawatts of power capacity, exceeding the energy draw of major international airports.
The industry faces a structural challenge where reliance on the existing power grid creates direct competition with local communities for energy resources.

backlog.title: Xiaomi delivers 50,168 cars in October as EREVs account for over half of total
backlog.summary:
October deliveries rose 3.11% year-on-year and 25.37% sequentially to a year-to-date high, just 44 vehicles short of the all-time record.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Xiaomi Auto delivered 50,168 vehicles in October, a year-to-date high that nearly matched its all-time monthly record.
The newly launched Sky Nomad EREV series drove growth, accounting for over 50% of total monthly deliveries for the first time.
Xiaomi is actively preparing for international expansion, having signed MOUs with eight German dealer groups to support a planned 2027 European entry.

backlog.title: The climate case for AI has not been made
backlog.summary: This week, as countries meet in Antalya, Turkey for the United Nations climate conference, one topic likely to dominate the conversation is artificial intelligence. The host has already called on countries to commit to ensuring that AI is designed, powered, and deployed in ways that support climate action. But so far, industries around the world…
bullets: While AI companies project significant emissions reductions by 2035, current market data shows little evidence that major industrial players are adopting the necessary AI-driven strategies.
Academic models suggest AI could cut global emissions by up to 5.4 billion tons annually, but these projections remain largely aspirational rather than operational.
The power sector represents the most concrete potential for AI-driven climate impact through supply and demand forecasting, yet actual deployment remains behind theoretical expectations.

backlog.title: BYD reaches 19 million NEV production milestone as Fang Cheng Bao opens Tai 9 reservations
backlog.summary:
BYD produced an additional 2 million NEVs in 124 days.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD reached the 19 millionth NEV production milestone, accelerating its output to add 2 million units in just 124 days.
The sub-brand Fang Cheng Bao has opened reservations for the Tai 9, a 6-seat plug-in hybrid SUV that will serve as the brand's largest model.
The Tai 9 will debut BYD's new DMS hybrid platform, incorporating second-generation Blade Battery technology and advanced flash charging capabilities.

backlog.title: Memory In Physical AI
backlog.summary:
LPDDR6 becomes an essential ingredient as intelligence moves into autonomous and mobile edge systems.
The post Memory In Physical AI appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: LPDDR6 memory is emerging as a critical component for autonomous and mobile edge systems, where battery life is the primary constraint on operational utility.
Physical AI applications, such as humanoid robots and drones, require optimized data hierarchies to balance processing efficiency with power consumption.
Industry experts emphasize that extending the runtime of mobile AI platforms necessitates denser, faster memory architectures and more efficient data movement between processors.
The integration of advanced memory technologies is essential to maximize performance in edge-based AI while maintaining cost-effective hardware designs.

backlog.title: Nio flagship SUV ES9 nears 40,000 deliveries as large SUVs underpin brand sales
backlog.summary:
The ES9 is expected to reach its 40,000th delivery this week; as of the end of October, cumulative deliveries totaled 38,917 units.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Nio's flagship ES9 SUV is set to hit 40,000 cumulative deliveries this week, achieving this milestone in less than six months since market entry.
The ES9 and ES8 models have become critical to Nio's performance, collectively accounting for 85.25% of the brand's total deliveries in October.
Despite the success of its large SUVs, Nio's overall brand deliveries faced pressure in October, ending a 31-month streak of year-on-year growth.

backlog.title: Nio October deliveries breakdown: ES8 falls to year-to-date low, still lead company sales
backlog.summary:

For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Nio's ES8 deliveries fell to a year-to-date low of 8,738 units in October, though it remains the company's best-selling model.
Sales concentration remains high, with the ES8 and ES9 combined contributing over 85% of Nio's main-brand monthly volume.
Other models, including the ET5 Touring and ES6, saw significant year-on-year declines, with the ES6 hitting its lowest delivery level of the year.

backlog.title: Innovating with AI in the special chemicals industry
backlog.summary: As companies look to accelerate innovation with artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and advanced modeling, the primary challenge is connecting new technologies to reliable data, scientific expertise, and the practical realities of bringing products to market. For specialty chemicals manufacturer Lubrizol, digital transformation is all about giving researchers the tools to test ideas faster, make better-informed…
bullets: Specialty chemical manufacturer Lubrizol is utilizing AI and cloud-based digital modeling to accelerate R&D cycles and evaluate sustainable material formulations.
The company employs 'fusion teams' to bridge the gap between data scientists and traditional chemists, ensuring that AI tools augment rather than replace scientific judgment.
Cloud infrastructure allows chemical firms to scale research capabilities without the capital expenditure required to build and maintain proprietary data centers.

backlog.title: Maserati reportedly to partner with Maextro on localized production in China
